name: Ibiza, Biodiversity and Culture
description: Ibiza is a Balearic island in the Mediterranean, about 150 km off Spain's eastern coast. Beyond its famous party scene, its coastal waters hold dense meadows of Posidonia seagrass, found only in the Mediterranean, that shelter abundant marine life. On land, you can explore Phoenician-Carthaginian ruins and the Renaissance walls of Alta Vila, the fortified Upper Town.
